title: NekoStream’s new design
question: Choose the look to build directly in your Android development app.

options.label: Season guide
options.thesis: Your anime season at a glance, with the next episode always easy to find.
options.viewport: A compact NekoStream app bar, library heading, current-watching shelf, status filters, and a readable poster grid.
options.risk: The continue-watching shelf needs restraint so a large library remains quick to scan.

raised.raise: Progress must be readable before tapping.
Each action explains the task it performs.
Time and watched states receive explicit text labels.
Keep one task dominant in each section.

options.label: Anime shelf
options.thesis: A familiar, polished anime library with artwork first and progress close at hand.
options.viewport: A bold library title, watching shelf, status chips, search, and three-column posters.
options.risk: Familiar and effective, but closer to existing anime catalog apps.

options.label: Night queue
options.thesis: An ordered watching queue with the nearest episode pulled forward.
options.viewport: An ordered watching queue with the nearest episode pulled forward.
options.risk: The bitmap face and layered depth weaken long-title readability.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.

options.label: Episode counter
options.thesis: Watched and total episode counters lead the library.
options.viewport: Watched and total episode counters lead the library.
options.risk: Counters dominate artwork and obscure discovery.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.
options.kept: Progress must be readable before tapping.

options.label: Season atlas
options.thesis: Seasonal anime become ranked anchors in a browseable field.
options.viewport: Seasonal anime become ranked anchors in a browseable field.
options.risk: Spatial browsing slows finding a known title.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.

options.label: Anime district
options.thesis: Library, discovery, and airing occupy a labeled neighborhood.
options.viewport: Library, discovery, and airing occupy a labeled neighborhood.
options.risk: Illustrative navigation takes more effort than native tabs.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.
options.kept: Each action explains the task it performs.

options.label: Broadcast horizon
options.thesis: Airing and watching are organized in clearly labeled time bands.
options.viewport: Airing and watching are organized in clearly labeled time bands.
options.risk: Atmosphere competes with the art and obscures dense library content.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.
options.kept: Time and watched states receive explicit text labels.

options.label: Watching garden
options.thesis: Progress organizes the watching list into active regions.
options.viewport: Progress organizes the watching list into active regions.
options.risk: Physics and moving labels make everyday tasks harder.
options.case: Lower audience identification and task clarity than the seasonal guide.
options.kept: Keep one task dominant in each section.

canonCard.label: Familiar anime app
canonCard.thesis: A conventional anime catalog, executed with clear native controls.
canonCard.viewport: Library filters above posters, with airing, discovery, and account tabs.
canonCard.risk: Visually similar to other anime tracking apps.
